The effort fix landed on main as commit 44996b923. Delegate bb2644e8 ("Find why relaunch dropped effort") reported it done. The fix adds `chosen_effort` with migration 0178, and its proof run was ALL PASS in 233s.

The root cause was that the continuation relaunch passed no effort, so the CLI defaulted to medium. The EFFORT_READ handler then overwrote the owner's xhigh setting.
